stories.title: Serco hires Supplee to lead North American arm
stories.why: Barbara Supplee will now lead Serco North America's strategy centered around areas like autonomy and modernization, among others.

stories.title: FBI officials say AI is bolstering adversaries, emphasizing need to focus on cyber basics, patching
stories.why: The remarks, to both CyberScoop and at the Billington CyberSecurity Summit, dovetail with the release of a new bureau cyber strategy.

stories.title: Pentagon partners with venture studio to pilot shared services contract model via $100M OTA
stories.why: This unique agreement is designed to demonstrate a new framework where vendors are paid only for the costs they eliminate for DOD.

stories.title: Northrop Grumman Lands $4.8B Army Contract for CIRCM Missile Defense Systems
stories.why: Northrop Grumman’s CIRCM system uses a dual-jammer configuration to protect Army aircraft from infrared-guided missile threats.

stories.title: DISA Seeks Offers for $21.6B Joint Warfighting Cloud Capability UCM Core IDIQ
stories.why: The Defense Information Systems Agency has requested offers for the potential $21.6 billion JWCC UCM Core cloud IDIQ contract.

stories.title: Microsoft discloses two actively exploited zero-days among 974 vulnerabilities
stories.why: While the vendor hit another monthly record, it hasn’t resulted in a flood of active exploits.

stories.title: Compliance doesn’t win wars
stories.why: Every military capability is ultimately judged by its contribution to combat effectiveness.
